sections.label: NEA haze advisories update
sections.summary: NEA asked for an update on Sumatra and Kalimantan and has been issuing daily haze advisories to the public.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA also asked for an update on the situation in Sumatra and Kalimantan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA has been issuing daily haze advisories to the public.

sections.label: Haze Task Force monitoring and assistance
sections.summary: NEA and other agencies will monitor the situation and roll out measures, while Singapore assists Indonesia and supported haze-free ASEAN efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA, together with other agencies under the Haze Task Force, will closely monitor the situation and roll out further measures as necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Singapore is committed to assisting Indonesia in its efforts to deal with land and forest fires.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In June this year, we offered our haze assistance package to Indonesia to support its fire mitigation efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Over the past year, Singapore has been active in facilitating the exchange of best practices on peatland fire management as well as the development of the Roadmap to a Haze-free ASEAN 2020, which was just adopted last month.

sections.label: Green Label printing paper procurement
sections.summary: The Singapore Government will only procure printing paper products carrying the Singapore Green Label.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Singapore Government has announced that it will only procure printing paper products that carry the Singapore Green Label, which indicates that the supplier practises sustainable forestry management and does not clear land using fire.

sections.label: Singapore firefighting assistance offer
sections.summary: If activated, Singapore will offer C-130 aircraft, SCDF teams, cloud seeding and satellite pictures of fires.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: If activated, Singapore will offer up to two C-130 aircraft to ferry firefighting assistance team from the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF), a team from SCDF to share firefighting assessment and planning assistance with our Indonesian counterparts, one C-130 aircraft to help cloud seeding and higher resolution satellite pictures of fires and the coordinates of the fire sites.
